title: Session Replay Needlepoint Dashboard
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design and prototype a compact session-replay dashboard that surfaces a single-session, needlepoint view of failed requests and retries. The goal is to let engineers and SREs quickly reconstruct the sequence of events leading to an error, compare payload diffs between retries, and correlate failures with rollout windows and cost deltas without leaving the Console. This is intended for inclusion in the Request Forensics area of the Console and to complement the existing trace timeline views.
background: Customers have asked for a single-pane way to see 'what happened to this user/session' with failed requests, retries, and model variant shifts visible together.

Existing designs show single-request timelines or aggregated heatmaps. This design focuses on session reconstruction and quick hypothesis validation (payload diff, KV cache snapshot, model variant switch).
Target users: backend engineers, on-call SREs, solutions engineers during enterprise investigations.
goals: Show ordered sequence of requests in a session with clear failure markers and retry chains.
Offer inline payload diffing and kv-cache snapshot comparison for consecutive requests.
Highlight rollouts/model-variant changes and tag requests that occurred during canaries or fallbacks.
Surface per-request cost delta and token breakdown to aid cost-aware debugging.
Enable quick export of a session snapshot to an eval or incident ticket.
tasks: Prototype compact card layout for session lane with scrubber and mini-timeline
Design payload diff modal with redaction controls and 'show full/trimmed' toggle
Add rollout overlay: timeline band marking canary/A-B windows and annotated variant names
Define API contract with eng for 'session-replay-segments' (pagination, redaction, minimal payload)
Create Figma prototype flows: open session -> inspect retry -> compare payloads -> export snapshot
User test with 6 engineers and 3 SREs, iterate on edge cases (long sessions, many retries)
Produce accessibility checklist (keyboard nav, color contrast for error states)
acceptance_criteria: Session lane shows ordered requests with timestamps, status (200/4xx/5xx/retry) and retry grouping
Clicking a request opens a payload inspector with side-by-side diffs and a note widget for manual annotations
Rollout overlay correctly maps requests to model variants and shows canary windows with hover details
Cost column present showing per-request token count and estimated token cost, plus delta compared to previous request
Export button creates a JSON snapshot and opens a prepopulated PM/incident ticket template for downstream linking
Prototype validated by at least 5 participants and updated to address top 3 usability blockers listed in feedback
design_notes: Prefer compact rows so a 30–60s session with ~50 requests fits on a single desktop view; collapse long non-failure stretches into 'ellipsis' groups
Payload diffs are computed server-side; UI should request only diff metadata initially and fetch full bodies on demand to reduce cost and latency
Redaction: default to PII-safe view. Provide 'Show raw' toggled by users with 'view_raw' entitlement. Work with security for KMS audit trail.
Rollout overlay uses color-coded bands; preserve color-blind friendly palette and add pattern overlays for additional affordance
Cost estimates: reuse backend cost-per-token service; surface as microbars next to time to visually compare
Consider 'pin to eval' CTA to attach snapshot to an existing prompt/regression suite in Optimize
review_feedback: PM (Miguel Ortega): prioritize export-to-incident for enterprise pilot; add link to customer account and api-key id
Eng (Priya Menon): requires new API endpoints; flagged potential perf risk for sessions with large binary payloads; suggested server-side sampling
Security (Omar Rahman): redaction defaults approved; require audit log entry when 'Show raw' used; recommend adding a consent flag in storage
Design lead (Harper Lee): row density is good but increase hit target for request items and add keyboard scrubbing controls
SRE (Zachary Mills): add quick 'retry-simulate' hypothesis button that replays request against a sandbox model variant (backend dependency)
Accessibility review: ensure error icons include textual labels; keyboard focus order must move left-to-right along session lane
usability_test_findings: Participants appreciated inline cost delta; said it often changed triage priority
Some users expected the rollout overlay to allow filtering to only requests during a selected window; added as follow-up
Payload diff modal was confusing when multiple retries had identical payloads — added 'identical' badge and collapse option
Users wanted a 'jump-to-first-failure' shortcut — added to prototype navigation
open_questions: What retention policy applies to stored full payload snapshots for exported incidents? (legal/security input required)
Should we show token-level highlights for differences inside prompt templates or only top-level fields?
What permission scope is required to use 'retry-simulate' and pin snapshots to evals?
For very long sessions, should we auto-cluster by 5-minute buckets or based on request similarity?
next_steps: Finalize Figma v2 with engineering notes and deliverables by 2026-02-28
Sync with ENG-55122 to align on 'session-replay-segments' API shape and pagination contract
Create engineering spike ticket to prototype server-side diff generation and cost metadata retrieval
Coordinate with Security to document auditing and retention decisions before enabling 'Show raw' globally
Schedule cross-team review with PM and SREs the week of 2026-03-02
